goals._track_note: Track A — Trust Foundation (G1-G5). Structural correctness of the DDD primitive/module/service layers.
goals.title: Primitives ship with scenarios
goals._status_enum: Allowed values: TBD | IN-PROGRESS | YES | NO | PARTIAL | DEFER. Flipped to YES only when all AC pass and evidence is locked. PO-only authorship per Charter §4.5.
goals.calibration: 3-5 TypeScript primitives in src/primitive/; each has ≥3 scenarios (golden + edge + failure). Candidates: hexagram-resolver, hao-encoder, ngu-hanh-classifier, reading-scorer, nuclear-hexagram-computer. dev-kinh-dich confirms exact set in Phase 0. grep src/primitive/ for infrastructure imports must return 0.

goals.title: Module composes primitives via ports
goals.calibration: One module: src/module/reading_composer/. Port: MarkovPort (infra provides SQLite impl, injected by composition root, never directly imported by module). Module must import zero infrastructure. Has ≥1 multi-primitive scenario (full KinhDichReading story: 6 scores → complete reading). grep src/module/reading_composer/ for src/infrastructure must return 0.

goals.title: Microservice has clean composition root
goals.calibration: src/index.ts ≤80 lines; OpenAPI YAML present in src/interface/; zero domain-op grep (computeReading/classifyNguHanh/resolveHexagram/encodeHaos must not appear in index.ts). Port = 5005 (internal == external) per system-map.json — never hardcoded.

goals.title: Architecture fence enforced (offline ESLint boundaries evidence)
goals._title_note: TS service: ESLint fence per SI-3 Option A (eslint-plugin-boundaries v6.0.2). NOT Go depguard. Spec LOCKED at charter v1 — SI-3 §5 'spec is final at charter v1'.
goals.calibration: Fence tool: eslint-plugin-boundaries (Option A) in apps/kinh-dich-service/eslint.config.mjs. devDependencies: eslint + eslint-plugin-boundaries. CI command: bunx eslint src/ --max-warnings 0. Pre-revert tag: kinh-dich-pre-ci. Deliberate-violation protocol: inject Fence-A import in src/primitive/hexagram-resolver/index.ts → non-zero exit + 'Fence-A' in output → revert → exit 0 + git clean → violation NEVER committed. R-FENCE gate: AC-4b proof must succeed on real .js-suffixed ESM import style. Fallback if R-2 bites: add @typescript-eslint/parser (5-min Option-A internal fix). Full template: charter §G4 eslint.config.mjs block.

goals.title: Old service code deleted + HTTP rewire
goals.calibration: Port = 5005 (internal == external) per system-map.json. G5a: superseded domain/services.ts logic moved to src/_deprecated/ (or deleted under kinh-dich-pre-delete tag). G5b: MCP tool handlers confirmed routing HTTP to port 5005 with zero direct domain imports — dev-kinh-dich confirms exact tools in Phase 0. G5c: grep TODO.*migrat = 0. Pre-delete tag: kinh-dich-pre-delete.

goals._track_note: Track B — Dashboard Trust (G6-G9). User-facing trust layer: honest rendering, zero-credential sandbox, user confirmation.
goals.title: Three-level dashboard renders from JSON traces
goals.calibration: Dashboard path: apps/kinh-dich-service/dashboard/index.html. 3 panels: primitives (3-5 cards) + module (reading_composer card) + microservice (service composition card). file:// works with zero network calls and zero external API calls. Renders from scenario trace JSON. NOTE: SI-2 fleet index (docs/dashboards/index.html) is stock-price's G6 deliverable — do NOT claim or touch it here.

goals.title: Edit-JSON-and-rerun works (zero credentials in sandbox)
goals.calibration: Env audit: env | grep -E 'DB_|API_KEY|SECRET|TOKEN|PASSWORD' returns empty. Sandbox runner: bun run sandbox / bunx ts-node sandbox/ (or equivalent). Rerun handler invokes sandbox against edited scenario JSON. Zero SQLite connection in primitive/module execution path (hexagram logic is pure compute). No KINH_DICH_DB_PATH or equivalent in sandbox env.

goals.title: Red/green status is honest
goals.calibration: Test A = deliberate corruption of golden scenario (e.g. flip expected hexagram number in hexagram-resolver golden, or flip expected dynamic value in ngu-hanh-classifier golden) → dashboard RED, diff captured. Test B = known-good golden → dashboard GREEN, diff null. Both proven before G8 grades YES. Pattern identical across all pilots.

goals.title: Dashboard is the trust contract (Path A user verbal OR Path B PO Playwright)
goals._title_note: Path B (PO Playwright headless) is Day-0 default per L6 carry-over from TA cycle-19 + macro cycle-53.
goals.calibration: Path A: user verbal YES to 'Can you tell from this dashboard whether kinh-dich hexagram resolution is working correctly?' recorded in docs/po-decisions/<date>-g9-kinh-dich-user-confirmation.md. Path B (default): PO Playwright + chromium-headless-shell against file://apps/kinh-dich-service/dashboard/index.html via Terminal.app TCC-stage (L87). Acceptance: ZERO console errors / pageerrors / requestfailed, all 3 panel cards rendered, NOT-RUN status honestly displayed.

goals._track_note: Track C — AI-Fixability (G10-G12). Proves the agent loop can self-correct without human intervention.
goals.title: AI agent fixes a primitive bug without looping (≤2 cycles)
goals.calibration: Baseline: docs/data/bug-inventory.json kinh_dich_baseline.baselineCycleCount (fallback 1.5 if <2 bugs in 60d window). max_cycles_allowed=2. Inject 1 deliberate single-literal bug in a primitive (e.g., wrong threshold constant in hao-encoder: LAO_DUONG_THRESHOLD = 0.85 instead of 0.75, or flipped comparison in reading-scorer). Measure dev-kinh-dich cycles to GREEN.

goals.title: Regression alarm bell works
goals.calibration: 2-trial coupling-proof (TA cycle-17 / macro cycle-57 precedent). Trial-1 = G10 alias primitive mutation + fix; verify ≥1 coupled scenario RED + single-edit fix repairs all. Trial-2 = DIFFERENT primitive mutation + fix; same coupling proof. Outcome-(a) × 2 = PASS.

decisionMatrix._authorship_rule: PO-only per Charter §Constraints + §4.5. Populated ONLY after 12/12 G-goals reach terminal grade. Atomic with last G-goal flips in same commit. NO partial population. NO pre-filling before 12/12. Block stays present-but-empty (TBD) the entire pilot until terminal.
decisionMatrix._criteria_source: Charter §Decision Matrix derivation: Speed = G10 + G11; Trust = G9 (PASS) + G8; Scale = all 12 goals YES + sprintCount ≤ 6.
decisionMatrix._speed_note: YES if G10=YES AND G11=YES. Apply mechanically — no PO discretion.
decisionMatrix._trust_note: YES if G9=YES (PASS grade, not PARTIAL) AND G8=YES.
decisionMatrix._scale_note: YES if all 12 G-goals YES AND sprintCount ≤ 6.
decisionMatrix._verdict_enum: TBD until matrix terminal. Then one of: scale | rescope | stop-MVR. Derived mechanically: 3×YES → scale; 2×YES → rescope; 0-1×YES → stop-MVR.

_verdict_note: Mirrors decisionMatrix.verdict. TBD during ACTIVE. Set to scale | rescope | stop-MVR at terminal close.
_goalsEarned_note: Running counter of goals with status=YES. Incremented by whoever flips each goal. Must equal 12 at terminal close.
